title: Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Guidance for Non-Blind Image Deblurring
title_zh: 频率解耦扩散引导：用于非盲图像去模糊的方法

paragraphs.en: Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Guidance for Non-Blind Image Deblurring

paragraphs.en: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful image priors for training-free posterior sampling in image restoration. To guide this sampling process, frequency-aware methods progressively incorporate measurement information across frequency bands, facilitating coarse-to-fine reconstruction. However, existing methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. In this work, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance to separate frequency activation from attenuation-aware spectral regularization. Specifically, a progressive low-to-high frequency schedule determines the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components. To stabilize the sampling process, we also introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations. For a fixed endpoint energy, we provide a KL-regularized path-space interpretation. In practice, we construct time-dependent guidance through local energy corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on natural-image benchmarks demonstrate strong PSNR and SSIM performance across challenging non-blind deblurring settings, even at higher measurement noise levels.
paragraphs.zh: 预训练的扩散模型为图像恢复中的无训练后验采样提供了强大的图像先验。 为了引导这一采样过程，频率感知方法逐步将不同频带的测量信息融入其中，从而促进从粗略到精细的重建。 然而，现有方法通常并未明确区分频率激活与由退化引起的衰减，导致非活跃频率之间的衰减差异未能得到充分建模。 在本工作中，我们提出了频率解耦的后验引导方法，以将频率激活与感知衰减的谱正则化分离开来。 具体而言，一个从低频到高频的渐进式调度方案决定了活跃的测量频带，而由核函数导出的衰减图则为非活跃成分定义了选择性的谱先验。 为了稳定采样过程，我们还引入了一种局部轨迹正则化器，以抑制状态向干净状态转换过程中空间上的不规则偏差。 对于固定的终点能量，我们提供了一种基于KL正则化的路径空间解释。 在实际应用中，我们通过使用Tweedie插件近似法，利用局部能量修正来构建随时间变化的引导机制。 在自然图像基准数据集上的实验表明，即使在较高的测量噪声水平下，该方法在具有挑战性的非盲去模糊任务中仍能展现出优异的PSNR和SSIM性能。

paragraphs.en: Classical methods design the prior through handcrafted regularizers, while more recent approaches use learned denoisers or energy models ( Rudin et al., 1992 ; Cai et al., 2012 ; Glowinski et al., 2017 ; Su and Huang, 2026 ; Roth and Black, 2005 ; Venkatakrishnan et al., 2013 ; Dong et al., 2015 ) . Diffusion models provide an expressive alternative by learning the score fields of progressively perturbed data distributions ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Conditional diffusion models can learn a direct degraded-to-clean mapping, but typically require paired data and task-specific training ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Whang et al., 2022 ) . Zero-shot methods instead combine a pretrained unconditional diffusion model with the known forward operator at inference time ( Kawar et al., 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhu et al., 2023 ) . This decoupling of the image prior from the observation model enables one pretrained model to address multiple inverse problems without retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 传统方法通过人工设计的正则化项来设计先验，而较新的方法则使用学习到的去噪器或能量模型（Rudin 等，1992；Cai 等，2012；Glowinski 等，2017；Su 和 Huang，2026；Roth 和 Black，2005；Venkatakrishnan 等，2013；Dong 等，2015）。 扩散模型通过学习逐步扰动后的数据分布的得分场，提供了一种更具表现力的替代方案（Ho 等，2020；Song 等，2021；Huang 等，2026）。 条件扩散模型能够学习从退化图像到清晰图像的直接映射，但通常需要成对的数据和针对特定任务的训练（Saharia 等，2022；Whang 等，2022）。 零样本方法则在推理时将预训练的无条件扩散模型与已知的正向算子相结合（Kawar 等，2022；Song 等，2023；Wang 等，2023；Chung 等，2023；Zhu 等，2023）。 这种将图像先验与观测模型解耦的方法使得一个预训练模型无需重新训练即可解决多个逆问题。

paragraphs.en: Despite this flexibility, existing zero-shot methods commonly enforce measurement consistency through spatial residuals, pseudoinverse projections, or likelihood gradients ( Kawar et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2023 ; Chung et al., 2023 ; Meng and Kabashima, 2025 ) . For natural images, diffusion denoising often recovers coarse structure before fine detail ( Falck et al., 2025 ) . This behavior has motivated frequency-aware guidance, which progressively incorporates measurement information across frequency bands. FGPS follows this principle by gradually exposing measurement frequencies ( Thaker et al., 2025 ) ; noise-conditioned posterior continuation further couples frequency activation to the diffusion noise level ( Tian et al., 2026 ) . However, existing frequency-aware methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. This distinction matters for directional or frequency-selective blur, where frequencies at similar spatial scales can have substantially different responses.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管具有这种灵活性，现有的零样本方法通常通过空间残差、伪逆投影或似然梯度来强制实现测量一致性（Kawar 等人，2022；Wang 等人，2023；Chung 等人，2023；Meng 和 Kabashima，2025）。 对于自然图像，扩散去噪通常在恢复精细细节之前先恢复出粗略的结构（Falck 等人，2025）。 这种行为促使了频率感知引导方法的出现，该方法逐步将不同频带的测量信息整合进来。 FGPS 遵循这一原则，通过逐步引入测量频率来实现（Thaker 等人，2025）；而基于噪声条件化的后验延续方法则进一步将频率激活与扩散噪声水平耦合起来（Tian 等人，2026）。 然而，现有的频率感知方法通常并未明确区分频率激活与由图像退化引起的衰减，导致非活跃频率之间的衰减差异未能得到充分建模。 对于方向性选择或频率选择性的模糊问题而言，这种区别至关重要，因为处于相似空间尺度上的不同频率可能表现出截然不同的响应。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these observations, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance for non-blind image deblurring. By decoupling frequency activation from attenuation-aware regularization, our approach enables more precise incorporation of measurement information, effectively preventing highly attenuated or noisy frequencies from corrupting the update direction. Meanwhile, it better models inactive components by preventing the diffusion prior from introducing hallucination artifacts in spectral regions where measurement data is absent or severely degraded. Additionally, we introduce a local trajectory-stabilization regularizer that penalizes spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations, thereby promoting stable and spatially coherent sampling. Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 受这些观察结果的启发，我们提出了一种频率解耦的后验引导方法，用于非盲图像去模糊。 通过将频率激活与衰减感知正则化解耦，我们的方法能够更精确地融入测量信息，有效防止高度衰减或含噪的频率破坏更新方向。 同时，该方法通过阻止扩散先验在测量数据缺失或严重劣化的频谱区域中引入幻觉伪影，从而更好地建模非活跃成分。 此外，我们还引入了一种局部轨迹稳定正则化器，用于惩罚空间上不规则的状态到清晰状态的偏差，从而促进稳定且空间连贯的采样。 我们的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Conditional diffusion models learn restoration distributions from paired degraded and clean images. SR3 ( Saharia et al., 2023 ) conditions the reverse process on a low-resolution observation for image super-resolution, while Palette ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) extends conditional diffusion to a broader family of image-to-image tasks. I 2 SB ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , IR-SDE ( Luo et al., 2023 ) , and ResShift ( Yue et al., 2023 ) further incorporate the degradation process into the diffusion bridge or stochastic restoration dynamics. Their learned models or conditioning mechanisms are typically tied to the degradation distributions used in training.
paragraphs.zh: 条件扩散模型通过成对的退化图像和清晰图像来学习恢复分布。 SR3（Saharia 等人，2023）在图像超分辨率任务中，将反向过程的条件设定为低分辨率观测结果；而 Palette（Saharia 等人，2022）则将条件扩散扩展到了更广泛的图像到图像任务家族中。 I²SB（Liu 等人，2023）、IR-SDE（Luo 等人，2023）和 ResShift（Yue 等人，2023）进一步将退化过程整合到扩散桥或随机恢复动力学中。 它们所学习的模型或条件机制通常与训练过程中使用的退化分布紧密相关。

paragraphs.en: Operator information and measurement guidance. DDRM ( Kawar et al., 2022 ) exploits the singular-vector structure of linear operators, while DDNM ( Wang et al., 2023 ) uses a range–null-space decomposition. DPS ( Chung et al., 2023 ) evaluates a likelihood surrogate at a denoised clean-image estimate; DMPS ( Meng and Kabashima, 2025 ) instead derives a closed-form likelihood-score approximation that avoids back-propagation through the denoiser.
paragraphs.zh: 操作者信息与测量指导。 DDRM（Kawar 等人，2022）利用了线性算子的奇异向量结构，而 DDNM（Wang 等人，2023）则使用了值域–零空间分解。 DPS（Chung 等人，2023）在去噪后的干净图像估计值上评估一个似然代理；而 DMPS（Meng 和 Kabashima，2025）则推导出了一个闭式似然分数近似，从而避免了通过去噪器进行反向传播。

paragraphs.en: Frequency exposure and stabilization. A related line of work controls which frequency components are exposed to measurement consistency during sampling. FGPS ( Thaker et al., 2025 ) progressively exposes measurement frequencies during sampling. Noise-conditioned posterior continuation ( Tian et al., 2026 ) combines frequency exposure with a Haar-domain rule for committing coarse and detail corrections. MASF ( Qian et al., 2024 ) stabilizes generation by averaging frequency components of clean-image predictions across sampling steps. Our method uses kernel-derived attenuation to weight a spectral prior over inactive frequencies and regularizes state-to-clean deviations locally.
paragraphs.zh: 频率暴露与稳定化。 一项相关研究控制了采样过程中哪些频率成分会被暴露于测量一致性检查中。 FGPS（Thaker 等，2025）在采样过程中逐步暴露测量频率。 噪声条件化的后验延续（Tian 等，2026）将频率暴露与哈尔域规则相结合，用于确定粗略修正和细节修正。 MASF（Qian 等，2024）通过跨采样步骤对干净图像预测的频率成分进行平均来稳定生成过程。 我们的方法利用核函数衍生的衰减来对非活跃频率上的谱先验进行加权，并对状态到干净图像的偏差进行局部正则化。

paragraphs.en: Variational and reconstruction-oriented methods. Diffusion priors can also be incorporated into iterative reconstruction and explicit optimization objectives. DiffPIR ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) combines diffusion denoising with plug-and-play restoration, while RED-Diff ( Mardani et al., 2024 ) uses variational approximation and denoising regularization. paragraphs.en: Our method ranks first in both PSNR and SSIM for all three FFHQ tasks. Relative to the strongest competing result in each setting, it improves PSNR by 0.149 0.149 , 0.187 0.187 , and 0.231 0.231 dB for Gaussian, motion, and uniform deblurring, respectively. The improvement is therefore consistent across the three blur models and is largest under uniform deblurring, where the operator-specific CGJ branch is used. Compared with FGPS, which also uses a progressive frequency curriculum, our method improves PSNR by more than 2 2 dB and SSIM by at least 0.062 0.062 in every FFHQ setting. These results show that explicitly separating diffusion-time frequency activation from degradation-dependent spectral sensitivity substantially strengthens measurement-faithful reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有三个 FFHQ 任务中，我们的方法在 PSNR 和 SSIM 指标上均排名第一。 与每种设置下最强的竞争结果相比，在高斯、运动和均匀去模糊任务中，我们的方法分别将 PSNR 提升了 0.149 0.149、0.187 0.187 和 0.231 0.231 dB。 因此，这种改进在三种模糊模型中均保持一致，并且在均匀去模糊场景下最为显著，此时使用了针对特定算子的 CGJ 分支。 与同样采用渐进频率课程设计的 FGPS 相比，我们的方法在所有 FFHQ 设置中都将 PSNR 提升了超过 2 2 dB，并将 SSIM 提升了至少 0.062 0.062。 这些结果表明，明确将扩散时间频率激活与退化相关的谱灵敏度分离开来，能够显著增强对测量结果的忠实重建能力。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduced frequency-decoupled posterior guidance, a training-free framework that separates the diffusion-time activation of measurement frequencies from their reliability under the degradation operator. A progressive low-to-high schedule specifies the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map weights the remaining inactive frequencies for spectral regularization. We provided a KL-regularized path-space interpretation of the fixed endpoint energy and derived practical stepwise guidance through a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on challenging non-blind deblurring tasks demonstrate consistent improvements in reconstruction fidelity and robustness to increased measurement noise. These results highlight the importance of jointly considering the evolving frequency content of reverse diffusion and the spectral properties of the degradation operator, and motivate further extensions to blind and nonlinear inverse problems as well as more efficient single-trajectory sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了频率解耦后验引导方法，这是一种无需训练的框架，能够将测量频率在扩散过程中的激活与其在退化算子作用下的可靠性分离开来。 一种渐进式从低到高的调度方案用于指定活跃的测量频段，而通过核函数导出的衰减图则对剩余的非活跃频率进行加权，以实现光谱正则化。 我们提供了固定终点能量的 KL 正则化路径空间解释，并通过 Tweedie 插件近似法推导出了实用的分步引导方法。 在具有挑战性的非盲去模糊任务中的实验表明，该方法在重建保真度和对增强测量噪声的鲁棒性方面均表现出一致的提升。 这些结果凸显了同时考虑反向扩散过程中不断变化的频率成分以及退化算子的光谱特性的重要性，并为进一步扩展到盲反问题和非线性反问题，以及更高效的单轨迹采样提供了动力。

paragraphs.en: Because our primary objective in non-blind image inverse problems is faithful recovery of the specific image associated with each measurement, we first report PSNR and SSIM in the main text. The complementary LPIPS and FID results are reported in Table 5 . The results reveal a clear separation between paired fidelity and perceptual quality. Although DPS-MAP and DMPS are among the strongest baselines in PSNR and SSIM, their LPIPS and FID values are frequently worse than those of FGPS and DSG, particularly on FFHQ. The main exception is ImageNet motion deblurring, where DPS-MAP achieves the best LPIPS and the second-best FID; DMPS also obtains a competitive LPIPS in this setting, although its FID remains high. Overall, FGPS achieves the best FID in all six settings and the best LPIPS in five of them, while DSG is generally the next strongest perceptual baseline. Our method does not dominate these perceptual metrics: its results often lie between the perception-oriented baselines and the strong distortion-oriented solvers, consistent with its emphasis on measurement-faithful recovery. These observations motivate reporting LPIPS and FID alongside, rather than in place of, the paired PSNR and SSIM results.

sents.zh: 由于我们在非盲图像反问题中的主要目标是忠实地恢复与每次测量相关的特定图像，因此我们首先在正文中报告了 PSNR 和 SSIM。

sents.en: The complementary LPIPS and FID results are reported in Table 5 .
sents.zh: 补充的 LPIPS 和 FID 结果列于表 5 中。

sents.en: The results reveal a clear separation between paired fidelity and perceptual quality.
sents.zh: 这些结果揭示了成对保真度与感知质量之间的明显差异。

sents.en: Although DPS-MAP and DMPS are among the strongest baselines in PSNR and SSIM, their LPIPS and FID values are frequently worse than those of FGPS and DSG, particularly on FFHQ.
sents.zh: 尽管 DPS-MAP 和 DMPS 在 PSNR 和 SSIM 方面属于最强的基线方法之一，但它们的 LPIPS 和 FID 值通常比 FGPS 和 DSG 更差，尤其是在 FFHQ 数据集上。

sents.en: The main exception is ImageNet motion deblurring, where DPS-MAP achieves the best LPIPS and the second-best FID; DMPS also obtains a competitive LPIPS in this setting, although its FID remains high.
sents.zh: 主要例外是 ImageNet 运动去模糊任务，其中 DPS-MAP 获得了最佳的 LPIPS 和次佳的 FID；DMPS 在此设置中也获得了具有竞争力的 LPIPS，尽管其 FID 仍然较高。

sents.en: Overall, FGPS achieves the best FID in all six settings and the best LPIPS in five of them, while DSG is generally the next strongest perceptual baseline.
sents.zh: 总体而言，FGPS 在全部六个设置中均获得了最佳的 FID，并在其中五个设置中获得了最佳的 LPIPS，而 DSG 通常是感知质量方面第二强的基线方法。

sents.en: Our method does not dominate these perceptual metrics: its results often lie between the perception-oriented baselines and the strong distortion-oriented solvers, consistent with its emphasis on measurement-faithful recovery.
sents.zh: 我们的方法在这些感知指标上并未占据绝对优势：其结果通常介于以感知为导向的基线方法和以失真抑制为目标的强求解器之间，这与它强调测量忠实恢复的特性一致。

sents.en: These observations motivate reporting LPIPS and FID alongside, rather than in place of, the paired PSNR and SSIM results.
sents.zh: 这些观察结果促使我们在报告成对的 PSNR 和 SSIM 结果时，同时提供 LPIPS 和 FID，而非仅依赖后者。

sents.en: As shown in Table 7 , the unified configuration improves all three metrics on both datasets.
sents.zh: 如表 7 所示，统一配置在两个数据集上均提升了所有三项指标。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 8 , the CGJ two-branch variant increases PSNR from 29.108 29.108 to 29.160 29.160 dB and improves both SSIM and LPIPS. The PSNR improvement is 0.052 0.052 dB, with higher PSNR on 919 of the 1000 paired reconstructions.

sents.en: As shown in Table 8 , the CGJ two-branch variant increases PSNR from 29.108 29.108 to 29.160 29.160 dB and improves both SSIM and LPIPS.

paragraphs.en: Our final reconstruction combines two independently completed sampling trajectories by a fixed output-space weighted fusion. For Gaussian and motion deblurring, the two branches are DDPM and DDIM. For uniform deblurring, the DDPM branch is replaced by the CGJ-DDPM branch. The fusion weights are fixed for each task and are applied to the final reconstructed images rather than during the reverse diffusion process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的最终重建通过固定的输出空间加权融合，将两条独立完成的采样轨迹结合起来。 对于高斯去模糊和运动去模糊，两个分支分别是 DDPM 和 DDIM。 对于均匀去模糊，DDPM 分支被 CGJ-DDPM 分支所替代。 融合权重在每项任务中都是固定的，并应用于最终重建的图像，而非反向扩散过程中。

sents.en: Our final reconstruction combines two independently completed sampling trajectories by a fixed output-space weighted fusion.
sents.zh: 我们的最终重建通过固定的输出空间加权融合，将两条独立完成的采样轨迹结合起来。

sents.en: For Gaussian and motion deblurring, the two branches are DDPM and DDIM.
sents.zh: 对于高斯去模糊和运动去模糊，两个分支分别是 DDPM 和 DDIM。

sents.en: For uniform deblurring, the DDPM branch is replaced by the CGJ-DDPM branch.
sents.zh: 对于均匀去模糊，DDPM 分支被 CGJ-DDPM 分支所替代。

sents.en: The fusion weights are fixed for each task and are applied to the final reconstructed images rather than during the reverse diffusion process.
sents.zh: 融合权重在每项任务中都是固定的，并应用于最终重建的图像，而非反向扩散过程中。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 9 , the two-branch reconstruction improves both PSNR and SSIM over either constituent branch in all six settings. Relative to the better single branch, the PSNR gains are 0.292 0.292 , 0.493 0.493 , and 0.385 0.385 dB on FFHQ Gaussian, motion, and uniform deblurring, and 0.037 0.037 , 0.159 0.159 , and 0.276 0.276 dB on the corresponding ImageNet settings. The fused reconstruction also improves LPIPS relative to the DDIM branch, while the DDPM or CGJ-DDPM branch retains the lower LPIPS.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 9 所示，在所有六种设置中，双分支重建在 PSNR 和 SSIM 方面均优于任一单独分支。 与表现更优的单分支相比，在 FFHQ Gaussian、motion 和 uniform deblurring 上，PSNR 分别提升了 0.292、0.292、0.493 和 0.385 dB；在对应的 ImageNet 设置中，则分别提升了 0.037、0.159 和 0.276 dB。 融合后的重建在 LPIPS 方面也优于 DDIM 分支，而 DDPM 或 CGJ-DDPM 分支则保持了更低的 LPIPS 值。

sents.en: As shown in Table 9 , the two-branch reconstruction improves both PSNR and SSIM over either constituent branch in all six settings.
sents.zh: 如表 9 所示，在所有六种设置中，双分支重建在 PSNR 和 SSIM 方面均优于任一单独分支。

sents.en: Relative to the better single branch, the PSNR gains are 0.292 0.292 , 0.493 0.493 , and 0.385 0.385 dB on FFHQ Gaussian, motion, and uniform deblurring, and 0.037 0.037 , 0.159 0.159 , and 0.276 0.276 dB on the corresponding ImageNet settings.
sents.zh: 与表现更优的单分支相比，在 FFHQ Gaussian、motion 和 uniform deblurring 上，PSNR 分别提升了 0.292、0.292、0.493 和 0.385 dB；在对应的 ImageNet 设置中，则分别提升了 0.037、0.159 和 0.276 dB。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 10 , the paired results are consistent with the aggregate comparison. On FFHQ, our method improves PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS over both DPS-MAP and DMPS for all three blur operators, with all corresponding confidence intervals excluding zero. On ImageNet Gaussian deblurring, our method improves PSNR and SSIM over both baselines, while LPIPS shows a fidelity–perception trade-off. For ImageNet motion deblurring, DPS-MAP remains stronger across all three metrics, whereas our method improves PSNR and SSIM over DMPS but yields a slightly higher LPIPS. For ImageNet uniform deblurring, the PSNR difference relative to DPS-MAP is small and its confidence interval includes zero, while SSIM and LPIPS favor our method. Relative to DMPS, our method improves all three metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 10 所示，配对结果与汇总比较结果一致。 在 FFHQ 数据集上，对于所有三种模糊算子，我们的方法在 PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 指标上均优于 DPS-MAP 和 DMPS，且所有对应的置信区间均不包含零。 在 ImageNet 高斯去模糊任务中，我们的方法在 PSNR 和 SSIM 指标上优于两种基线方法，而 LPIPS 则表现出保真度与感知质量之间的权衡。 对于 ImageNet 运动去模糊任务，DPS-MAP 在所有三项指标上仍表现更优，而我们的方法在 PSNR 和 SSIM 上优于 DMPS，但 LPIPS 略高。 对于 ImageNet 均匀去模糊任务，与 DPS-MAP 相比，PSNR 的差异很小且其置信区间包含零，而 SSIM 和 LPIPS 则更倾向于我们的方法。 与 DMPS 相比，我们的方法在三项指标上均有提升。

sents.en: Each activation computes a fresh Tweedie prediction, adding 150 UNet evaluations to the two 1000-step trajectories.
sents.zh: 每次激活都会计算一个新的 Tweedie 预测值，从而在两条 1000 步的轨迹基础上增加 150 次 UNet 评估。

sents.en: The resulting total is therefore 2150 UNet evaluations per image.
sents.zh: 因此，每张图像的总评估次数为 2150 次 UNet 评估。

paragraphs.en: The CGJ correction also performs five conjugate-gradient iterations per activation, corresponding to 750 CG iterations per reconstructed image. These iterations involve applications of the implemented forward and adjoint operators and are not counted as diffusion-model NFE. DPS-MAP likewise uses a conjugate-gradient measurement correction, with 20 CG iterations in its measurement-space solve.
paragraphs.zh: CGJ 校正在每个激活步骤中还执行五次共轭梯度迭代，相当于每幅重建图像进行 750 次 CG 迭代。 这些迭代涉及已实现的正向和伴随算子的应用，不计入扩散模型的 NFE。 DPS-MAP 同样使用共轭梯度测量校正，其测量空间求解包含 20 次 CG 迭代。

paragraphs.en: The baseline sampling budgets are task dependent. DPS, DSG, and FGPS use 1000 UNet evaluations in all reported settings. DPS-MAP uses 1000 respaced reverse steps on FFHQ and 100 steps on ImageNet. DMPS uses 100 steps on FFHQ and ImageNet Gaussian deblurring, and 1000 steps on ImageNet motion and uniform deblurring.
paragraphs.zh: 基线采样预算因任务而异。 DPS、DSG 和 FGPS 在所有报告的设置中均使用 1000 次 UNet 评估。 DPS-MAP 在 FFHQ 上使用 1000 次重排反向步骤，在 ImageNet 上使用 100 次步骤。 DMPS 在 FFHQ 和 ImageNet 的高斯去模糊任务中使用 100 次步骤，在 ImageNet 的运动和均匀去模糊任务中使用 1000 次步骤。
